findings.title: Missing header: Content-Security-Policy
findings.description: The HTTP response does not include the Content-Security-Policy header.
findings.evidence: Header 'Content-Security-Policy' not present in response from http://localhost:8080
findings.risk: Browser security controls may not be enforced.
findings.recommendation: Add 'Content-Security-Policy' to server or nginx configuration.

findings.description: The Server header reveals software version information.

findings.title: Demo config file accessible: /static/env-demo.txt
findings.description: A configuration/demo file is publicly accessible at http://localhost:8080/static/env-demo.txt
findings.risk: Exposed demo configs reveal patterns used in real configs and may expose secrets if misconfigured.
findings.recommendation: Remove or restrict access to config/env files. Block via nginx location rule.

findings.title: Debug endpoint accessible and exposes config
findings.description: /debug is publicly accessible (HTTP 200) and appears to expose environment/config information.
findings.evidence: HTTP 200 for http://localhost:8080/debug; response contains debug indicators: True
findings.risk: Exposed debug endpoints may leak environment variables, credentials, and system info.
findings.recommendation: Disable debug endpoint in production. Return 404 or remove the route entirely.

findings.title: Directory listing not detected
findings.description: /static/ does not appear to expose a directory listing.

findings.title: PostgreSQL port 5432 exposed on host
findings.description: Port 5432 (PostgreSQL) is accessible on localhost.
findings.risk: Exposed database ports increase attack surface. Direct access enables brute-force and exploitation attempts.
findings.recommendation: Remove port mapping from docker-compose.yml. Database should only be accessible within the Docker network.

findings.title: HSTS header missing
findings.description: The Strict-Transport-Security header is not present.
findings.evidence: Header 'Strict-Transport-Security' not found in response from http://localhost:8080
findings.risk: Without HSTS, browsers may connect over HTTP, enabling downgrade attacks.
findings.recommendation: Add 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains' to nginx configuration.

findings.title: CORS header absent
findings.description: No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header present — cross-origin requests are not explicitly permitted.

findings.title: Cookie missing security flags: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite
findings.description: A cookie is set without one or more of the Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite attributes.
findings.risk: Missing HttpOnly exposes the cookie to theft via XSS; missing Secure allows it to travel over plain HTTP; missing SameSite enables CSRF.
findings.recommendation: Set 'Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict' on session cookies.

findings.title: No WAF detected in front of the application
findings.description: An obvious XSS/SQLi payload was not blocked; no web application firewall appears to be filtering requests.
findings.evidence: Attack payload returned HTTP 200 (expected 403/406 if a WAF were present)
findings.risk: Without a WAF, exploit attempts reach the application directly, removing a layer of defence-in-depth.
findings.recommendation: Deploy a WAF such as ModSecurity with the OWASP Core Rule Set in front of the app (see docs/WAF.md).

findings.title: No dangerous HTTP methods enabled
findings.description: The server does not advertise TRACE, TRACK, CONNECT, PUT, or DELETE.

findings.title: HTTP is not redirected to HTTPS
findings.description: Plain HTTP request returned HTTP 200 without redirecting to HTTPS.
findings.risk: Traffic served over plain HTTP can be intercepted or modified (MITM) and is exposed to SSL-stripping downgrade attacks.
findings.recommendation: Configure the web server to 301-redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS, and pair it with HSTS.

findings.title: X-Powered-By header absent
findings.description: No X-Powered-By header in response.

limitations: This is a local educational lab — not a production security audit.

Results require manual validation before any action.
